display.purpose: Commanding headlines, proof values, and short italic provocations.

body.purpose: Operating detail, labels, forms, prices, and navigation.

shadows.name: dossier-depth
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the single black hero dossier.

shadows.name: flat-offset
shadows.purpose: A controlled second sheet for profile and booking placeholders.

motion.name: direct-feedback
motion.purpose: Two-pixel lift and color inversion for interactive controls.

motion.name: editorial-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time section entry, removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Champagne Appointment Button
components.description: A square, tightly typeset appointment action reserved for the masthead and decisive conversion moments.
components.css: .nav-cta { min-height:48px; border:1px solid var(--champagne); border-radius:0; background:var(--champagne); color:var(--ink); font:750 12px/1.1 Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.105em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Private Brief
components.description: A black lacquer operating dossier with a claret tab, numbered method, champagne rules, and SK monogram.
components.css: .playbook-board { border:1px solid var(--champagne); border-radius:0; padding:42px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--ivory); box-shadow:0 28px 52px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ink),transparent 76%); transform:rotate(-2deg); }

components.name: Proof Ledger
components.description: A ruled black report that pairs an operating claim with an oversized champagne result.
components.css: .ledger-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--champagne),transparent 50%); padding:24px 0; background:var(--ink); color:var(--ivory); }

components.name: Private Field
components.description: An explicitly labeled square field with a high-contrast rule and visible claret focus state.
components.css: input { min-height:54px; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:0; padding:13px 16px; background:var(--ivory); color:var(--ink); } input:focus { border-color:var(--claret); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--claret),transparent 78%); }

narrative.creativeNorthStar: A founder opens a slim black laptop in a paneled hotel bar between a board meeting and dinner; the screen reads like private commercial intelligence.
